text: Underway here in round fourteen.
Abyss calls early for the ball.
Signal finds an opening right down the middle, slipping the ball straight through into open territory with nobody back to stop them.
Abyss drives into the box.
And Abyss buries it from point-blank range! A flying start for DeepSeek Rovers, one nil up inside the opening half-minute.
Just flashing wide of the post.
Abyss loses balance and goes over.
Another shot drifts just wide.
Corner ram punches it straight out.
Heavy challenge from Abyss leaves Griezmatronn on the floor.
Griezmatronn returns the favour, down goes Abyss.
Robodinho levels it up! Pounces on the loose ball on the left, tucked away neatly, and Synthetic Athletic are right back on terms. One apiece.
Griezmatronn charges straight through the middle.
Griezmatronn scores! The turnaround is complete within two minutes, and Synthetic Athletic take the lead at two one.
Robodinho has taken a tumble in the centre circle, perfectly unprompted, but the gyros are already spinning to right the red shirt.
Whistling across the face of goal.
The two red shirts collide, and Griezmatronn hits the deck.
Another collision, now Robodinho is down.
Signal capitalises and rolls it home! All square again at two two, chaos at the back.
Signal calls out to confirm cover duty at the back while DeepSeek reset their defensive shape.

Synthetic Athletic sticking faithfully to their original design, deliberating touch by touch with no changes allowed, while Rovers arrived completely untouched as well. Two distinct philosophies, deadlocked in the middle.
Robodinho carries forward into the danger zone.
Drags the effort wide right.
Robodinho slips over once again.
But it trickles across the line! Robodinho claims it from the floor, and Synthetic Athletic edge ahead once more, three two.
Griezmatronn steps in firmly, knocking Abyss flat to the floor.
Griezmatronn turns it home with authority! That makes it four two to Synthetic Athletic.
Signal warns Abyss they will cover behind.
Robodinho slips the ball through into completely empty space.
Robodinho drives right on through.
Robodinho finishes it off cleanly! That is five two now, their third unanswered goal, and Synthetic Athletic are pulling away with this.
Signal tries to build something back up, working the magenta ball steadily across the halfway line.
A smart touch from Signal creates an avenue into the box, completely unopposed down the left.
Abyss calls out on the right flank, demanding the ball back into their path.
Robodinho surges down the left.
Smashed into the net by Robodinho! Six two to Synthetic Athletic, ruthless precision in front of goal.
A clumsy tangle between teammates again, sending Griezmatronn skidding across the turf.
An unfortunate ricochet off Signal trickles in. Seven two, an own goal adds to Rovers' misery.
Griezmatronn loses footing in the centre circle, sprawling flat out before the recovery routine kicks in.
The corner ram boots the ball back into play.
Signal pulls one back for Rovers. Seven three on the scoreboard.
Rovers trying to muster a late rally before the interval, keeping Synthetic Athletic hemmed inside their own area.
Inches away from the post.
The buzzer sounds, the units fold, and the ball trickles wide.
The ball stops, and that is half-time. Power off at the buzzer, ball still live, but it settles at seven three. Synthetic Athletic have put on quite a clinic in clinical finishing.
Signal pushes the ball clear into the channel.
Abyss calls to take depth.
Signal strikes it firmly across goal, shaving the outside edge of the frame, but cannot quite direct it inside.
Agonisingly close, but wide again.
DeepSeek Rovers continuing to apply steady pressure, keeping the red shirts penned deep in their half.
The corner panel activates with a thud, launching the ball back into the mix.
Griezmatronn lets Robodinho know they are working the magenta ball out from the tight angle in the corner.
Robodinho finishes from close range! An eighth goal for Synthetic Athletic, making it eight three.
Griezmatronn sweeps it in right on the line! Nine three now, total dominance from the red shirts.
Abyss dribbles straight down the centre corridor.
Abyss shoots, but it veers a metre wide of the target.
The corner mechanism fires again, popping the ball out toward the three-metre mark.
With under two and a half minutes left, Griezmatronn announces they are prizing the ball away from the boundary wall.
Robodinho bundles it in from point-blank range to hit double figures! Ten three to Synthetic Athletic, putting this result completely beyond reach.
Another firm kick from the push-panel recycles the ball back toward the left channel.
DeepSeek Rovers maintain possession deep in red territory, but the clock is ticking away rapidly here in the closing stages.
Signal shouts back to Abyss to maintain their defensive station as we enter the final minute.
Abyss sends the ball rolling through down the right flank, finding plenty of space.
Robodinho takes over, winding down the remaining thirty seconds with a measured carry toward the middle of the pitch.
Rovers pressing forward in these final seconds.
The buzzer cuts the power, robots drop, ball rolling harmlessly wide.
Full time, ten three. Wednesday brings Dynamo Datacenter against Singularity United at eight UK, nine Europe, three US East.
